finding.summary: Provider-derived 13:11 UTC data reports 118.55M cbXRP collateral and $59.20M USDC debt in the 62.5% Morpho market. Coinbase separately reports 150.94M cbXRP supply and 150.94M XRP reserves; its displayed refresh timezone is unstated.
finding.interpretation: Approximate market collateral share is 78.5% of cbXRP supply. Since Aug24, collateral units rose about 30.6%, supply 28.7%, and outstanding debt 44.4%. Credit use appears to have grown faster than collateral units, but this is not evidence of new XRP spot purchases.

critical_corrections: Call 12.68% a liquidation bonus, not a borrower penalty.
Separate USDC supplied from cbXRP collateral units.
90.4% utilization is USDC borrowed divided by USDC supplied.
40.0% debt/collateral is aggregate, not borrower-weighted LTV.
Exclude prior $240.85M value-secured field until reconciled.
Coinbase market attribution remains inference, not confirmed market-ID mapping.

Coinbase Help identifies the official cbXRP Base contract used for XRP loan collateral: 0xcb585250f852c6c6bf90434ab21a00f02833a4af; this confirms the collateral asset but not the exact Morpho market ID.

Coinbase's wrapped-asset policy says the underlying XRP reserve is held in custody and is not sold or deployed by Coinbase; wrapper issuance therefore must not be treated as proof of a Coinbase spot-market purchase.

forecast.reason: Raw-block replication, synchronized reserve timestamp and borrower-level distribution are missing.

next_actions: Reproduce cbXRP ERC-20 totalSupply and Morpho market collateral at an exact Base block.
Enumerate borrower positions and calculate borrower-level LTV/health-factor distribution.
Reconstruct the full Chainlink oracle/feed addresses and latest round at the same block.
Obtain Coinbase reserve refresh time with timezone or reconcile reserve addresses to a pinned XRPL ledger.
Enumerate all cbXRP holders and non-Morpho collateral venues.
Track the top three USDC vault suppliers and liquidity withdrawals.
Keep the snapshot exploratory-only until raw-block reconciliation; no directional forecast.
